content.short: Nest is a liquidity, growth and yield layer on Hyperliquid helping assets bootstrap markets.
content.description: Nest helps assets launch on Hyperliquid and bootstrap the liquidity they need to trade properly, combining concentrated liquidity markets with yield mechanics. Launching a token is straightforward; giving it a market deep enough that the price means something is the part that usually fails, which is the gap this addresses.
